اظطلمن (form VIII)
# اِظْطَلَمْنَ (iẓṭalamna) /iðˤ.tˤa.lam.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِظْطَلَمَ (iẓṭalama)
# اِظْطَلِمْنَ (iẓṭalimna) /iðˤ.tˤa.lim.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِظْطَلَمَ (iẓṭalama)
